notes: Conventions example (mw-e39.3), not shipped: quest ids are `quest-<slug>` (story bible 11.1), objective and resolution ids are plain kebab-case, facts are `<subject>.<state>`. Started by an effect (no `startWhen`). Real quests are written under E39.
title: The Empty Barge
summary: Mags Oakum's barge has gone down the river empty twice this week, and she hates running empty. Ottilie Marsh would like to know why.

objectives.text: Look for the Patient Ann at Briar Glen Quay.
Ask Mags why she runs empty.

resolutions.journal: Mags laughed, lit her pipe and said the river had been quiet. It had not. You noted that she did not look at the hold.
